paite: Mi'n bawngtal hiam, belam hiam gu in gou hiam zuak taleh; bawngtal khat gun in bawngtal nga, belam khat gun in belam li a adit ding ahi.
heading: Ditkik Nawnna Dante

paite: Guta inn luh kimu in, kivua in si taleh, avopa pen sisan suah chi a mohsak theih ahi kei ding.
Himahleh atung a ni asuah nung ahihleh sisan suah chi a mohpaih theih ahi ding. Ditna kim apiak ding ahi. Piak ding bangmah aneih keileh, aguktak ziak a amah zuak ding ahi.
Avan guk akhut a hing a akimuhleh, bawngtal hiam ahihkeileh sabiltung hiam, ahihkeileh belam hiam hitaleh, amun nih apiakkik ding ahi.
Mi'n lou hiam, grephuan hiam nek a omsak in, aganta lutsak in, midang lou ah va ta taleh; ama lou hoihna pen leh ama grephuan hoihna pen a pan ditna abawl ding ahi.
Mei hong kang in, ling lak hong kuang in, buh hiam ahihkeileh hai dingh lai hiam ahihkeileh lou kangse taleh; amei khahpa'n ditna abawl ngeingei ding ahi.
Mi'n a-invengpa kep ding in dangka sum hiam van hiam pekhia henla, huai mi inn a pan kigu taleh; guta akimuhleh azahnih pia hen.
Guta akimuh keileh, a-invengpa van tung ah akhut akha na hiam, chih theihna ding in vaihawmte kiang ah inn neipa api ding ahi.

Tatlekna chiteng, bawngtal thu ah hiam, sabiltung thu ah hiam, belam thu ah hiam, puansilh thu ah hiam, van mansak thu ah hiam, midang in kei a ahi, achihleh, alang tuak thu vaihawmte ma atut ding ahi. Vaihawmte mohpaihpa'n a-invengpa aleh nih apiak ding ahi.
Mi'n a-invengpa kiang ah akep ding in sabiltung hiam, bawngtal hiam, belam hiam gan himhim hiam pekhia henla; si hiam, liam hiam, hawlmang hiam a om in, kuamah in mu kei taleh;
TOUPA kichiamna amau gel kikal ah a-om dia; a-invengpa' van tung ah akhut akha kei chihna; avan neipa'n huai apom dia, adin kei ding hi.
Amah a pan guk a-omleh, aneipa kiang ah ditna abawl ding hi.
Gan balnen in ana om taleh, atheihpihna ding in asa hon tawi hen, balnen a om pen adin kei ding hi.
Mi'n a-invengpa banghiam khel henla, anei pen om louh kal in liam in hiam si hiam in om taleh, adit ngeingei ding ahi.
Himahleh aneipa akiang a om ahihleh adin kei ding. Van khelh man in adin khin lel hi.
Khamsa hilou nungak siangthou khat pasal in zol henla, kithuahpih taleh, mou man pia in zi in anei ngeingei ding ahi.
heading: Biakna Leh Gamtatna Dante

paite: Anumei pa'n akiang a piak anial bilbelleh, nungak siangthoute man dungzui in sum ape ding hi.
Dawizawl ahin na phal ding ahi kei.
Ganta kithuahpih peuhmah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
TOUPA kiang kia lou ngal, pathian himhim kiang a kithoih peuhmah hihsiat dimdem ding ahi.
Mikhual na subuai hiam, na nuaisiah hiam ding ahi kei hi; Aigupta gam a mikhual na hih tak ziak un.
Meithai hiam, pa nei lou naupang hiam na hihgenthei ding ahi kei.
Bangchiteng a amau na gentheihsak a, ka kiang a ahong kah peuhmah uleh, akahna uh ka ngaikhe ngeingei ding hi.
Ka thangpaihna asou dia, namsau in ka hon that ding hi. Na zite uh meithai ahi ding ua, na tate uh pa nei lou ahi ding uhi.
Na kiang ua om ka mite lak a mizawng kuapeuh kiang a sum na leitawi sakleh, leitawisakmi hih bang a sumpung na nek louh ding ahi.
Kichiamna a na inveng puansilh na lakleh, ni tum ma a ama kiang a na va piakkik ding ahi.
Huai lah akikhuhna neihsun ahi ngal a, avun a ding a apuansilh ahi. Bang in a-ihmu dia? Hichi ahi dia, ka kiang a, ahong kah chiang in ka za ding; hehpih thei ka hih ziak in.
Pathian na enghou ding ahi kei a, na mite vaihawmmi leng na hamsiat ding ahi kei hi.
Na theigah min masate, na uain masate lan ding in na zekai ding ahi kei. Na tapate lak a piang masapen kei na hon piak ding ahi.
Huchi mah bang in na bawngtalte lak ah leng na hih ding ahi. Na belamte lak ah leng hiai bang in na hih ding ahi. Ni sagih sung api kiang ah na omsak dia, ani giat ni a kei na hon piak ding ahi.
Kei a dia misiangthoute na hih ding uh ahi. Huaiziak in gamlak a gamsa nek bang sa himhim na nek louh ding uh ahi a; uite na pe zaw ding uhi.
